name: steward-onboarding
title: workstation-steward: a first session in the terminal
desc: An illustrative session, looping. It checks the npm release's provenance (SLSA v1), installs it through mise, runs steward init (nine files created with a receipt; the AI tooling add-on off, the projects add-on on under ~/Development, the Claude Code skills installed everywhere with PR consolidation), then runs steward sc plan, which takes gh 2.103.2, holds python@3.15 3.15.2 because it is two days old, and skips postgres 18 because a major upgrade is deliberate.

scenes.out: steward init: create your config in ~/.config/workstation-steward from the examples (9 files):
A few questions finish the setup. Each answer changes one line in steward.toml.

scenes.ask: Turn on the AI tooling add-on (Ruflo, AgentDB, AQE, Brain, RuVector: drift, repin, guards)? [y/N]
Turn on the projects add-on (discovery, the registry and onboarding of your projects)? [y/N]
Where do your projects live? Folders, separated by commas [~/Development]:

scenes.out: Install the steward's Claude Code skills (/steward:supply-chain and the rest)?
1) everywhere: every Claude Code session you start, in any folder
2) one project: only sessions started in a folder you name    3) not now

scenes.ask: Also include PR consolidation (folds a repo's Dependabot and Renovate PRs into one verified PR)? [y/N]

scenes.out: Set in ~/.config/workstation-steward/steward.toml: profiles.projects = true; skills.pr_consolidation = true

segs: postgres 16.15 -> 18 (major: upgrade deliberately with steward sc upgrade-tool postgres <version>)
